title: Plugin Event
description: One observation a Plugin drops into the Inbox for Ingest to consume. See CONTEXT.md: Plugin, Plugin Event, Inbox, Ingest; ADR 0013.

plugin.description: The Plugin that produced this event, e.g. "govee_ble", "tuya_lan" — matches sensor.plugin/plug.plugin.

external_id.description: The opaque per-Plugin device id this event is about — matches sensor.external_id/plug.external_id for the same plugin. For a "log" event this is repurposed as a free-form scope reference instead (e.g. "enclosure:3", "animal:12", or "app" when the entry isn't about any specific entity) — see CONTEXT.md: External ID, Log Event.

observed_at.description: UTC timestamp of the observation itself (not when Ingest processed it), formatted exactly like SQLite's datetime('now') — "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS", no 'T', no timezone suffix — so it sorts and compares correctly against every other recorded_at column in the database.

sensor_reading_payload.description: See CONTEXT.md: Reading. Any subset may be present — a plugin only reports what its device actually measures.

plug_state_payload.description: See CONTEXT.md: Ingest. Reported on every poll, not just on change — Ingest does the edge-detection.

plug_telemetry_payload.description: See CONTEXT.md: Data Capture. Written on a slower, independent cadence from plug_state; any subset may be present, or all null if the device exposes no telemetry.

log_payload.description: See CONTEXT.md: Log Event; ADR 0044. A free-form entry from a Plugin or an AI skill — not resolved against the Registry the way sensor_reading/plug_state/plug_telemetry are, so Ingest writes it straight through regardless of whether external_id matches any registered device.

care_event_payload.description: See CONTEXT.md: Care Event Plugin Event; ADR 0046. Written by a Skill (today, only log_husbandry) that has already resolved a Room/Enclosure/Animal name to a real id using its own Registry export — Ingest re-validates enclosure_id/animal_id still exist and still relate the way the event claims, and quarantines (rather than silently dropping) on a mismatch, since this represents a specific, human-confirmed action rather than a routine device poll.

animal_id.description: Spot-feed only — see CONTEXT.md: Spot-feed. Omit/null for a whole-Enclosure event.

food.description: Feeding only. Omit/null when the sentence didn't say — Ingest fills it in from the last Feeding.

count.description: Feeding only. Omit/null when the sentence didn't say.

prey_state.description: Feeding only. Omit/null when the sentence didn't say — Ingest falls back to the last Feeding's own value, or frozen_thawed if there's no prior Feeding.

result.description: Feeding only. Omit/null when the sentence didn't say — Ingest falls back to the last Feeding's own value, or accepted if there's no prior Feeding.
